think.note: REGRESSION vs Chat (86.4%): 2/6 reader calls hit done_reason=length (num_predict=600) — gemma4's think:false does not fully suppress deliberation; it interleaves per-candidate commentary into message.content mid-array, and at this pool composition (~21-candidate working pool) the array itself got cut before completing, corrupting the rank order. Root-caused with 3 mitigations tested: (1) num_predict 600->1200: WORSE (2 truncations, NDCG 24.9% — the model fills whatever budget it is given rather than converging); (2) prompt instructed 'JSON array first, no preamble/reasoning': still interleaves commentary mid-array, no improvement; (3) smaller pool (batch-tokens 1300->700, working-size 12->8): improved en to 67.7% (1 truncation) but REGRESSED ja 46.0%->22.0% (3 truncations) when applied uniformly — no single reader-parameter setting improves en without regressing ja at this scale/composition, so no fix was safe to ship without trading one language's regression for another. Reported unsmoothed at the original (default-config) settings shared by all three languages.
